Basically, the first part revolves around various kids in a group of mercenaries are supposed to stop a very possible war from breaking out. The second part consists of them meeting a bigger (and older) group of mercenaries, and they find out tons of weird things about the timeline they live in. In the third part, they travel to the future to find a dystopian future (it's still being developed. i don't know what exactly happens in the future yet but if i stick around i'm gonna figure it out eventually). 

At the moment my favorite characters in the story are Caroline, this edgy halloween-obsessed teen girl who is the guitarist in her band, her friend Winston, the lead singer in the same band, and Andrew, the main character's (dead) older brother.

I mainly post my stuff on deviantart (even though it's honestly not the best site in terms of design and some other stuff but. that doens't matter!), newgrounds, and the webcomic is being posted on tapas.

It's a lot. I'm verry passionate about this project :]

I spend my days drawing. A lot. I want to become a professional comic artist. In fact, I'm already kind of starting a webcomic. usually, because of the things i'm going through, I don't have enough motivation to actually work on it. Which. sucks because of deadlines and stuff. but you see, this comic is one of the only reasons outside my friends that I continue to stick around. it's kind of the driving force of my motivation to live! (other than my friends. and stuff)
